issue.title: Orchagent crashes after moving to libsaibcm_3.7.3.3-3

failure.body:
Orchagent process is crashing in Juniper QFX5210 platform after SAI library is moved to libsaibcm_3.7.3.3-3.

Prior to this commit, interfaces used to come up with libsaibcm_3.7.3.3-2:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/commit/590caaf5cfae54dd7b7d152f9a6fbc90cf83f4eb

[sonic_dump_sonic_20200401_165619.tar.gz](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/4414791/sonic_dump_sonic_20200401_165619.tar.gz)
